chapter: Zach White, Cotton Pickers and Cab Calloway
title: Missing the Terre Haute dance for a jam session in Indianapolis
summary: When Moten's bus was about to leave Indianapolis, Fulton and George Johnson arrived looking to cut Barefield. The whole band went back into the ballroom for a jam session instead of going to the dance.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: We'll get to that a little later. But you were telling me before about the time you were about to pull out, the bus was going to Terre Haute from where? Where were you, with Moten's band?

Yeah. We had played the dance in Indianapolis that night and the next day we were to meet in front of the ballroom to go to Terre Haute, Indiana and play at a dance that night. And everybody was in the bus loading up and everything, sitting there. And just as we got to pull out a guy in a little old raggedy Ford Runs in front of the bus and stops. Fulton jumps out and George Johnson jumps out. He says, where's Eddie Barefield, I come to cut him.

And so everybody gets right out of the bus, goes in the ballroom, opens up the piano and Basie starts playing. The first thing you know the whole band was in there jamming and we didn't get to the dance that night. Naturally we sent out and got some booze and things, and we just had a jam session right there.
